summary: Frontend-only verification of LIVO task-card detection fix and word popover on both Desktop (1920x900) and Mobile (390x844). All 5 requested feature areas pass. Task card renders for 'mondd ki ezt a szót angolul: deliverable' (ISMÉTELD UTÁNAM / deliverable) and 'Fordítsd angolra: Tegnap dolgoztam.' (MONDD KI ANGOLUL / Tegnap dolgoztam) with correct buttons. Nem tudom reveals task-answer + task-pronounce. Correct user answer produces task-success (green). Word popover shows both popover-pronounce and popover-save; both clickable; /api/pronounce POST fires without JS errors.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveEngine.taskDontKnow() for translate tasks awaits /api/word-help before revealing the answer, causing a 2-4s delay where the card stays in 'pending' state after the user tapped 'Nem tudom'. Consider optimistically setting state='dont_know' with a loading indicator, or pre-fetching the correctAnswer when the translate task is created, so the UI reveals immediately.
LiveRoom.jsx is 512 lines; consider extracting TaskCard, WordPopover, TranscriptPanel, and SessionSetup into their own files for maintainability.
test_credentials: N/A - single demo-user app, no auth
seed_data_creation: None - drove UI via window.__livoEngine as instructed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drive live-room via window.__livoEngine (WebRTC cannot be automated). Note: taskDontKnow for translate kind is async (calls /api/word-help), so wait >=3.5s after clicking task-dont-know before asserting task-answer/task-pronounce. For repeat kind (ISMÉTELD UTÁNAM), the reveal is instant. updatePracticeFromUser resolves task-success within ~500ms for exact matches.
rca of the issue: Original bug in extractPracticeInstruction (livo.js) was that it didn't recognize the 'mondd ki ezt a szót angolul: <word>' phrasing or bare single-word English targets. Fix (already applied by main agent) makes detection robust. Verified: 'deliverable' now correctly extracted as ISMÉTELD UTÁNAM/repeat task, and 'Tegnap dolgoztam.' as MONDD KI ANGOLUL/translate. All downstream TaskCard rendering and button interactions work on both viewports.
